paper.title: Hydrogen storage on highly porous novel corn grain-based carbon monoliths

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet, independent re-derivation of Table 1 + methods): 6 rows, 50/55 cells confirmed, 5 disputes all accepted by Agent C. 298 K/50 bar per-sample uptakes (MR-1/2 0.40, MR-1/3 0.41, MR-1/4 0.46; gravimetric magnetic-suspension microbalance) text-explicit; BET (2147/2541/2647), pore volumes and 4VT/SBET pore widths confirmed against Table 1. Accepted: synthesis_method chemical_activation->unknown (the paper names only 'carbonized char and activating agent' and defers the route to refs [17-19]; the agent is never named -- HYC-0024/0007 'assign only when stated' precedent); the 77 K per-sample uptakes are figure-only (the paper states only the collective max 2.39-2.45 wt%), so MR-1/2 = 2.39 anchored via its stated volumetric 10.01 g/L / piece density 0.420 (=2.38), and MR-1/3 & MR-1/4 = 2.45 as uptake_bound=upper (true value <=2.45); their extraction_method figure_estimated->text_direct (figure_estimated is banned for new rows, test_dataset_invariants). +micropore_volume_co2 (VDR CO2 0.508/0.422/0.515). Calibration WITHHELD (magnetic-suspension balance named, no buoyancy/void/blank procedure; the +/-0.0067 is an uncertainty). All 6 Tier B.

notes.type: uptake_type=unspecified (no excess/absolute/total word; paper says 'mass basis').
notes.mat: corn-grain activated carbon compressed with CMC-Na binder into monoliths. activated_carbon. synthesis_method=unknown: the paper names only 'carbonized char and activating agent' at char:agent 1:2/1:3/1:4 and defers the route to refs [17-19]; the activating agent is NOT named (HYC-0024/0007 precedent: assign chemical_activation only when stated).
notes.tex: SBET by BET (N2, 77 K, P/P0 0.01-0.05, ASAP 2020). total_pore_volume single-point at P/P0 0.99; micropore_volume = VDR(N2) (DR, probe N2); micropore_volume_co2 = VDR(CO2); average_pore_diameter = 4VT/SBET (geometric_from_S_V). piece density (no schema field) 0.420/0.323/0.292 g/cm3.
notes.m298: 298 K / 50 bar: gravimetric magnetic-suspension microbalance (Rubotherm); per-sample EXPLICIT (0.40/0.41/0.46, Sec 3.3). measurement error +/-0.0067 wt%.
notes.m77: 77 K / 1 bar: volumetric adsorption analyzer (ref [22]). Collective max 2.39-2.45 wt% (Fig 3, per-sample figure-only). MR-1/2 = 2.39 anchored (volumetric 10.01 g/L / piece density 0.420 = 2.38). MR-1/3, MR-1/4: per-sample 77 K not stated -> uptake_bound=upper at the 2.45 collective max (true value <=2.45).
notes.cal: calibration WITHHELD (magnetic-suspension balance named; no buoyancy/void/blank procedure; the +/-0.0067 is an uncertainty, not a calibration).
